name: rootMultiplicity_mul_X_sub_C_pow
statement: R[X]} {a : R} {n : ℕ} (h : p ≠ 0) : (p * (X - C a) ^ n).rootMultiplicity a = p.rootMultiplicity a + n

name: rootMultiplicity_X_sub_C_pow
statement: R) (n : ℕ) : rootMultiplicity a ((X - C a) ^ n) = n

name: pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C
statement: Type v} {s : I → K} (H : Function.Injective s) : Pairwise (IsCoprime on fun i : I => X - C (s i))

name: exists_multiset_roots
statement: ∀ {p : R[X]} (_ : p ≠ 0), ∃ s : Multiset R, (Multiset.card s : WithBot ℕ) ≤ degree p ∧ ∀ a, s.count a = rootMultiplicity a p | p, hp => haveI
